PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE 'btc_web/.*\.py$'; then btc_venv/bin/python3 -m py_compile "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -3; fi
PostToolUse.description: Syntax check Python files after edit

PreToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.(env|pem|key)$|credentials'; then echo 'BLOCKED: refusing to edit sensitive file'; exit 1; fi
PreToolUse.description: Block edits to secrets and credentials
